approvers: Owner decides alone; the glazing subcontractor and client may need to agree
reason: We spend about 885 euro a year on damage and just fix it at snagging from contingency. Paying around 19 euro per m2 up front, with a 150 m2 minimum and a deposit, makes no sense against that. Glazing damage is also the glazing subcontractor's problem until handover, not ours.
objection: I'd be paying thousands to prevent a cost of under 900 a year that I don't even carry myself, since the glazing sub is responsible until handover.
instead: Keep doing nothing, clean and polish at snagging, and push damage back to the glazing subcontractor. If needed, buy cheap film or tape locally.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that glazing damage is costing us several thousand euro a job, or the glazing subcontractor or client paying for the protection.
